نستزير (form X)
# نَسْتَزِيرُ (nastazīru) /nas.ta.ziː.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
# نَسْتَزِيرَ (nastazīra) /nas.ta.ziː.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
